image_description: A close-up shot of two individuals in academic regalia. The primary subject is a woman on the left wearing a black academic gown with blue and gold velvet panels on the front and sleeves, and a mortarboard cap. A secondary subject (man) is partially visible on the right, wearing a black gown with red accents. The image appears to be a candid photograph from a graduation ceremony.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a medium close-up crop; the lower portion of the gown (ankles/feet) is completely outside the frame, making full-length verification impossible.
The visible upper torso shows a clear center-front vertical division and symmetrical panel placement consistent with academic gown construction.
The fabric hangs loosely from the shoulders, successfully masking the underlying body shape, consistent with the 'voluminous' descriptor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While sleeve openings are visible, the arms are positioned such that the full extent of the sleeve drape relative to the hands is not clearly demonstrable or is cropped out.
Distinctive colored velvet panels (blue/gold) are visible on the front chest area, characteristic of doctoral or master's gowns.
A white collared shirt is visible at the neckline beneath the gown, confirming it is worn over other clothing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black fabric exhibits low specular reflection and heavy draping folds, consistent with matte polyester or wool blends used in regalia.
The surface texture appears smooth without high-gloss highlights, matching the 'non-reflective' criterion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The specific length of the sleeve extension past the wrist cannot be verified due to arm positioning and cropping.

To check for edge bleeding between the black gown and the background, and ensure the velvet panels are topologically connected to the main garment without floating artifacts.
To assess general photographic quality, noise levels, and detect any subtle generative distortions in facial features or fabric textures.

focus_areas: Integrity of the velvet panel boundaries (no melting into black fabric)
Naturalness of fabric folds and gravity-driven draping
Consistency of lighting on the face vs. the gown
Sharpness of the mortarboard tassel and brim

AI generators often struggle with the sharp transition of these materials, resulting in color bleeding or blurred boundaries. Also, verify that the mortarboard cap sits physically correctly on the head without warping the hairline unnaturally.
